takes.h: Subterranean publishes C. M. Eddy’s The Loved Dead and Other Tales
takes.p: Subterranean Press reports The Loved Dead and Other Tales by C. M. Eddy is in stock and shipping. The 220-page clothbound collection gathers thirteen tales, seven of them from Weird Tales, edited from the original handwritten manuscripts, with a new foreword by Jim Dyer and story headings reproduced from Andrew Brosnatch artwork.
